proposals.evidence: DEDR3754 explicitly gives Gadaba neliŋ/nelling moon/month and nelā month. Survey nelli/nelliŋ retains that same-language lunar month noun with source final-nasal variants preserved. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

Selected simple and ordinary tense/nominal forms retain that eat stem and its documented alternants; survey endings, voicing and vowels are preserved. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
